description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans task scheduler, including a mock implementation of IGrainContext, and various test methods verifying task scheduling, execution order, context propagation, and concurrency behavior within the Orleans runtime environment.

classes.name: UnitTestSchedulingContext
classes.description: A mock implementation of IGrainContext used for unit testing the Orleans task scheduler without requiring full grain activation.

classes.name: OrleansTaskSchedulerBasicTests
classes.description: Contains various unit tests to verify the behavior of the Orleans task scheduler, including task execution order, context propagation, and concurrency handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of UnitTestSchedulingContext with a specified ILoggerFactory.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources, particularly the scheduler if it implements IDisposable.

methods.name: Async_Task_Start_ActivationTaskScheduler
methods.description: Tests scheduling and execution of a simple task on the Orleans activation task scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_SimpleFifoTest
methods.description: Verifies that queued actions are executed in FIFO order.

methods.name: Sched_Task_TplFifoTest
methods.description: Verifies that queued tasks execute in order, affecting shared state as expected.

methods.name: Sched_Task_ClosureWorkItem_Wait
methods.description: Tests that multiple queued work items execute correctly and complete as expected.

methods.name: Sched_Task_TaskWorkItem_CurrentScheduler
methods.description: Verifies that tasks scheduled within work items run on the expected scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_Task_SubTaskExecutionSequencing
methods.description: Ensures that sub-tasks spawned within a scheduled work item execute serially.

methods.name: Sched_AC_RequestContext_StartNew_ContinueWith
methods.description: Verifies that RequestContext flows correctly across nested tasks and continuations.

methods.name: RequestContextProtectedInQueuedTasksTest
methods.description: Tests that the RequestContext is preserved when queuing tasks, including asynchronous and non-asynchronous work.

methods.name: AsyncCheckClearRequestContext
methods.description: Checks that RequestContext is cleared appropriately in asynchronous work.

methods.name: NonAsyncCheckClearRequestContext
methods.description: Checks that RequestContext is cleared in non-asynchronous work.

methods.name: LogContext
methods.description: Logs current task and runtime context information for debugging.

methods.name: InitSchedulerLogging
methods.description: Initializes logging configuration for scheduler-related tests.
